name: 陳詩雯
objective: Introduction to machine learning by Python programming. Regression analysis, dimension reduction, feature extraction, classification methods, neural networks, and LLM. Python examples to improve students' knowledge of machine learning.
schedule:
week1:	Introduction to machine learning
week2:	Probability and optimization
week3:	Feature Extraction
week4:	Bayesian decision theory
week5:	Regression
week6:	Neural Networks
week7:	CNNs
week8:	Hidden Markov Models
week9:	Mid-term presentation
week10:	LSTM and RNN
week11:   Attentions
week12:	Generative Models
week13:	Transformers
week14:	Autoencoders
week15:	Graphical NN
week16:	DDPM
week17:	Case Study
week18:	Final exam
materials: 1. Hui Jiang, Machine learning Fundamentals A Concise Introduction, Cambridge, 2021
consultation: Email: shihwen@mail.ntut.edu.twOffice Hours:Thursday 13:30-17:30Integrate Technology Complex, Room B09-1
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
